race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: This looks open but JAX EDGE and Binadham will find this easier than the handicaps they contested last time. Marginal preference is for the former, who won't be troubled by the return to 5f and has the services of a good-value claimer. Bonnie's Boy is also of interest. JAX EDGE BINADHAM (IRE) BONNIE'S BOY
